evidence: Computed in BigQuery on the loaded training table. f1 has Pearson correlation 0.9921 with label and Cohen d = 16.77 (near-perfect class separation: mean(label=0)=0.005 vs mean(label=1)=2.496). All other features are weak: corr f2=0.019, f3=0.122, f4=0.120, f5=-0.007, f6=0.081, all with Cohen d < 0.27. f1 predicts the outcome far too well to be a genuine feature, indicating it was computed from post-outcome data (leakage).
